name: rando-mbtiles
description: Squelette Capacitor : cartes raster en ligne + MBTiles hors-ligne, import/export GPX/KML/KMZ

scripts.sync: npm run vendor && npx cap sync android && node scripts/install-plugin.js
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.run:device: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.js assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.js assembleRelease
scripts.aab:release: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.js bundleRelease
